goal: kbdecide.py sweep sets status invalidated with invalidated_reason and invalidated_date when a context work item is dropped (done or deleted at sprint close is not), a cited source has superseded_by, a context article or domain is gone, or review_by has passed; a context fact whose fact_key no longer exists is flagged relink, not invalidated, and kbdecide.py relink ID --fact PATH:LINE repoints it; no row is ever deleted.
